youtube_title: Scrolling Till 2 Am Then Can't Sleep? Your Phone Is The Alarm | Body Fix #33 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #33. Just ONE reel... and it's 2 AM. Phone down, and sleep is GONE?
B is right. Phone away 30-60 MIN before bed. Screens keep your brain ON.
Bright light + endless new content: your brain stays alert, sleep gets pushed later.
Fix: Charge the phone in another room, same wake time daily, dark cool room.
Red flags: Weeks of no sleep, loud snoring with gasping, or bad days? Talk to a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - How to get to sleep
